title: Hello BadCode Picks
eyebrow: Hello, I'm BadCode · picture and music · round 1
heading: Start the video: the warm opening, BadCode, and the music
intro: Words wait for the picture (Jack). Pick the warm opening, BadCode's setting and the music; each row has a note. Every music take has its own player with a slider. The figure row uses the new short mask line with the mask photo attached; the long-sentence versions are underneath for comparison.

sections.lede: Each made from a real Unsplash photo with no faces, turned into the 00s / Frutiger Aero meme-edit feel.

groups.title: Which opening?
groups.line: Pick one (or say which to combine).

b: a sunlit pool from above, an inflatable ring
